title: Voladium Hub
features:
[Main Features]
Auto Farm Speed - Automated instant speed training with auto-cleanup for annoying popups.
Auto Rebirth - Fully automated rebirth progression system.
Auto Teleport - Instant teleportation to any selected win prize zone.
[Shop Features]
Auto Buy & Equip Trails - Smart step-by-step purchase sequence with a calibrated price index list. Automatically stays locked on the best owned item without glitching backwards.
Auto Buy & Equip Auras - Fully automated aura upgrade system that guarantees equipping only the highest tier available.
[UI & Extras]
Clean, customizable Ocean-themed Rayfield interface with built-in Key System.
